findings.evidence: `upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/PosDef.lean:310: lemma of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg {M : Matrix n n R} (hM1 : M.IsHermitian) (hM2 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ star x ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x)) : M.PosSemidef`, under `variable [Fintype n]` at line 295; this file already imports `Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PosDef` (line 8) and already uses the Fintype-only `hM.re_dotProduct_nonneg` at line 137.
findings.fix: Delete `of_submatrix_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg`, add `[Fintype n]` to `map_re` and `posSemidef_map_ofReal_iff`, and start both proofs from Mathlib's `Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg`; the submatrix step then drops out (`map_re`: `of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (hM.1.map re ..) fun x => by simpa [re_star_dotProduct_mulVec_ofReal] using hM.re_dotProduct_nonneg fun i => (x i : 𝕜)`; the `mpr` of the iff keeps its current `RCLike.nonneg_iff`/`re_star_dotProduct_map_ofReal_mulVec`/`IsHermitian.im_star_dotProduct_mulVec_self` body without `Matrix.submatrix_map`).
findings.issue: `PosSemidef.of_submatrix_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg` is a thin reshaping of `TauCeti.posSemidef_iff_finite_sum` whose only purpose is to let `PosSemidef.map_re` (line 133) and `posSemidef_map_ofReal_iff` (line 154) avoid `[Fintype n]`. No consumer needs that generality: both are used only on `Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℂ` (ComplexSpinDensity.lean:114 and :337), and the two identities those proofs rely on, `re_star_dotProduct_mulVec_ofReal` (line 123) and `re_star_dotProduct_map_ofReal_mulVec` (line 142), already carry `[Fintype n]` themselves.

findings.fix: Delete the two unused accessors (keep `mat_idxMM_idxPP_eq_mat_idxPP_idxMM`, which is used at line 273), or use them in `IsParityInvariant.re` instead of the raw projections.
findings.issue: `IsParityInvariant.mat_idxMM_idxMM_eq_mat_idxPP_idxPP` (line 231) and `IsParityInvariant.mat_idxMP_idxMP_eq_mat_idxPM_idxPM` (line 237) are `h.1` and `h.2.1` of the `∧`-bundle at line 226 and have no consumer: `IsParityInvariant.re` (line 254) writes `h.1, h.2.1` directly. The real `PDF.IsParityInvariant` (Positivity.lean:226) has no such accessors, so this is an unused parallel surface.

summary: The real/complex PSD transfer and the SpinDensityC API are new and reuse the existing real lemmas properly, but the new arbitrary-index wrapper around TauCeti's quadratic-form characterisation is unnecessary: Mathlib's Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg covers every consumer. Two parity accessors also duplicate the ∧-projections and are unused.
